papers.title: An Attention-Guided Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Boundary Integral Computation in Physical Field Reconstruction
papers.summary: In practical engineering and scientific computing, a real physical system can be reduced to a boundary value problem, and the adequate boundary information to determine the interior spatial distribution and evolutionary state of the physical field can be solved with linear equations, alternatively, the the real physical problem can be treated with boundary problems with in adequate information problems in field of machine learning. This paper proposes a deep learning framework for the recovery of missing boundary information using an attention-guided graph neural network (GNN) surrogate. The framework extracts features from the physical information on the discretized boundary into a latent space, and the missing boundary quantities are then predicted by the network. Thus, the nonlinear mapping from known boundary quantities to missing boundary quantities is learned using a variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture, while an attention mechanism is incorporated to better model the correlations among different types of boundary information. Furthermore, the interior physical field can be reconstructed using the conventional boundary element method (BEM) integral formulation. The effectiveness of the GNN-BEM framework is evaluated using numerical examples of the two-dimensional Laplace and Poisson equations, which demonstrate good performance in reconstruction accuracy, local detail preservation, and model stability. The results show that GNN-BEM provides a feasible computational framework for boundary information recovery and fast interior physical field reconstruction for partial differential equations under complex boundary conditions.
papers.title_ja: 物理場再構築における境界積分計算のためのアテンション誘導型グラフニューラルネットワークサロゲート
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、物理場の境界値問題において欠損した境界情報を補完し、内部物理場を高速に再構築するための深層学習フレームワークを提案する。アテンション機構を備えたグラフニューラルネットワーク（GNN）と変分オートエンコーダ（VAE）を用い、既知の境界量から欠損量を予測する非線形マッピングを学習する。予測された境界情報を用いて従来の境界要素法（BEM）で内部場を計算することで、複雑な境界条件を持つ偏微分方程式の効率的な解法を実現する。ラプラスおよびポアソン方程式の数値例により、再構築精度と計算効率の両面で有効性が示されている。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと物理情報計算の組み合わせであり、関心領域に直結

papers.title: When do explicit penalties improve flow matching?
papers.summary: Flow matching can learn structure directly from data, raising the question of when additional constraints improve generation. We study penalties that encode such constraints, with physics-informed flow matching as a motivating example. Satisfying a constraint more closely need not make the generated distribution more accurate. We therefore compare penalised and unpenalised generative modelling through their expected squared $2$-Wasserstein error. Our analysis covers both vector-valued and functional data in a Hilbert-space setting. We first derive geometric criteria that account for constraint violations and the distribution of samples after projection onto the constraint set. We then solve the statistical comparison explicitly for specific velocity-field classes and constraints via flow matching. In this model, penalisation improves accuracy exactly when the reduction in estimation variance outweighs the increase in squared bias. The resulting formula shows how this trade-off depends on sample size, the model class, the noise schedule, and the penalty weight.
papers.title_ja: 明示的なペナルティがフローマッチングを改善するのはいつか
papers.summary_ja: フローマッチングにおいて、物理情報などの制約をペナルティとして付加することが生成精度を向上させる条件を理論的に分析した。ヒルベルト空間設定下で、ペナルティ付きと無しのモデルを2-Wasserstein誤差の期待値で比較し、幾何学的基準を導出した。特定の速度場クラスと制約に対して、ペナルティが精度を改善するのは推定分散の減少が二乗バイアスの増加を上回るときであることを示した。このトレードオフはサンプルサイズ、モデルクラス、ノイズスケジュール、ペナルティ重みに依存する。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報と生成モデルの理論的比較であり、サロゲートモデル設計に直結する

papers.title: Comparative Study of Canvas- and Coordinate-Based Geometry-Conditioned Neural Networks for Real-Time Prediction of Indoor Environments with Varying Room Dimensions
papers.summary: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is computationally expensive for iterative building design. Deep learning surrogates offer faster predictions, but generalization across varying room dimensions remains challenging. This study compares two geometry-conditioned neural network surrogate models for rapid indoor airflow and temperature field prediction under varying room sizes. During the architectural design stage, this method is relevant for real-time assessment of whether conditioned supply air will effectively provide fresh and cool air throughout rooms with varying heights and lengths. The canvas-based neural network (CaNN) explicitly encodes room size by preserving different occupied regions within a fixed canvas, whereas the coordinate-based neural network (CoNN) uses normalized coordinate channels. Both employ U-Net autoencoders to separately predict airflow and temperature fields. Evaluation uses simplified rooms with varying heights and lengths as a controlled benchmark. The results show that CaNN achieves higher agreement with CFD results than CoNN, demonstrating its potential to support performance-driven building design.
papers.title_ja: 室内環境のリアルタイム予測におけるキャンバスベースと座標ベースの幾何条件付きニューラルネットワークの比較研究
papers.summary_ja: 計算流体力学（CFD）の計算コストを削減するため、変化する部屋サイズに対応するサロゲートモデルとして、キャンバスベース（CaNN）と座標ベース（CoNN）の2つの幾何条件付きニューラルネットワークを比較した。両モデルともU-Netオートエンコーダを用いて気流と温度場を予測し、異なる高さや長さを持つ簡易部屋でベンチマーク評価を行った。結果、CaNNの方がCFDとの一致度が高く、建築設計段階でのリアルタイム性能評価に有効であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理現象のサロゲートモデル化と汎化性能評価が関心に合致

papers.title: Physics-guided machine learning for saturation control across variable hydraulic conditions in heap leaching
papers.summary: Heap-leaching hydraulics vary between regions of an ore bed, motivating fast prediction models that accommodate different material properties. This study develops a parameter-conditioned physics-guided machine-learning (PGML) surrogate and demonstrates its use in simulated saturation control. A dataset of 4096 numerical Richards-equation trajectories was divided into 2867 training, 614 validation and 615 evaluation cases. The network predicts hourly saturation profiles from the current profile, irrigation rate and four hydraulic parameters, and is trained with an approximate Gardner mass-balance penalty. A daily predictive controller compared 200 constant irrigation rates over a 24-hour horizon. Across the evaluation cases, the median full-cycle tracking deviation was 4.9% of a 0.70 saturation target, equal to that of a tuned proportional-integral (PI) controller, while the PGML controller reached the target without overshoot in the median and applied approximately 4% less irrigation. Moderate physics guidance reduced long-horizon prediction error by approximately 30% relative to data-only training and reduced irrigation-bound activity, but slightly worsened closed-loop tracking. For a matched prediction workload, the surrogate was approximately 70 times faster than the numerical solver, and batched evaluation cost under 2 ms per column for 5000 columns. The results support a reusable physics-guided surrogate for large-scale saturation control in simulation.
papers.title_ja: 堆積浸出における可変水理条件にわたる飽和度制御のための物理ガイド型機械学習
papers.summary_ja: 堆積浸出プロセスの水理特性変化に対応するため、Richards方程式の数値解を学習データとする物理ガイド型機械学習（PGML）サロゲートモデルを構築した。このモデルは、現在の飽和度プロファイルと水理パラメータから将来の飽和度を予測し、Gardner質量保存則に基づくペナルティ項で物理的整合性を担保している。制御実験では、従来のPI制御と同等の追従精度を維持しつつ、灌水量を約4%削減し、数値ソルバー比で約70倍の高速推論を実現した。物理ガイドの導入により長期予測誤差が約30%低減される一方、閉ループ制御ではわずかに追従性能が低下する傾向も確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報とサロゲートモデルによる制御高速化が関心に合致

papers.title: From Simulated Fluids to Living Tissue: Zero-Shot Foundation Model Transfer to Perturbed Embryos
papers.summary: Morphogenesis is driven by the interplay of genetic regulation and tissue mechanics. In vivo video data is limited, particularly under genetic mutations and environmental perturbations, making generalization beyond the most representative conditions in the dataset challenging. However, at tissue scales, the dynamics of Drosophila can be described as a continuum flow, motivating the usage of representations learned across other physical systems as priors for developmental dynamics. We investigate finetuning Walrus, a Continuum Dynamics Foundation Model pretrained across a broad set of simulated continuous systems, on tissue velocity fields from only 12 wild-type Drosophila blastoderm videos. We evaluate autoregressive prediction both in-distribution and zero-shot under unseen temperature and genetic perturbations. Zero-shot refers to evaluation on perturbation conditions never seen during wild-type finetuning, without any additional training. In-distribution, a Fourier Neural Operator model trained from scratch achieves best performance on VRMSE. However, Walrus (CRPS) is the strongest model under the most severe distribution shift of unseen samples of mutated embryos and temperature conditions. Interestingly, predictions capture the shape of the mean surface tissue velocity trajectory and its separation between 17{\deg}C and 27{\deg}C, including the timing of the peak at Germ Band Extension onset, a biologically meaningful milestone of embryo development. Our results provide preliminary support that representations learned from different dynamical systems can transfer to experimental morphogenesis in developmental regimes, provided they admit a continuum description. More broadly, our results motivate further study of physics foundation models as a new complementary tool for the simulation of morphogenesis in low-data regimes.
papers.title_ja: シミュレーション流体から生体組織へ：摂動を受けた胚へのゼロショット基盤モデル転移
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、連続体力学のシミュレーションデータで事前学習された基盤モデル「Walrus」を、少数のショウジョウバエ胚の動画データでファインチューニングし、未見の温度や遺伝的摂動下での組織速度場の予測に適用する手法を提案する。評価の結果、分布内では従来手法が優位である一方、最も厳しい分布シフト（未見の摂動条件）下では、Walrus が最も高い予測性能を示した。特に、胚発生における生物学的マイルストーンである「Germ Band Extension」のタイミングや温度依存性を正しく捕捉できた点が示された。この結果は、連続体記述が可能な異なる動的システム間で学習された表現が、低データ環境での形態形成シミュレーションに転移可能であることを示唆している。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータと物理情報モデルの応用であり、低データ環境でのサロゲートモデル構築に直結する。

papers.title: Probabilistic Simulation of Gas-Liquid Interfaces with Coupled Flow Matching on Spherical Harmonics
papers.summary: Bubbly flows involve strongly coupled bubble motion, deformation, and hydrodynamic interactions, making high-fidelity simulation computationally expensive. We propose a neural surrogate that jointly predicts bubble trajectories and interface deformation in a compact, shared representation, replacing costly mesh-resolved simulation with fast generative inference. Because two-phase flow dynamics is nonlinear and chaotic, we treat forecasting as a conditional generative problem rather than deterministic regression, predicting entire future windows in a single pass. We train and evaluate the surrogate on BubbleSH, a Front-Tracking dataset of rising deformable bubble swarms, assessing performance using trajectory, shape, and distributional metrics over kinematic, morphological, and interaction-based properties. The surrogate reproduces key flow statistics while running several orders of magnitude faster than the underlying DNS solver.
papers.title_ja: 球面調和関数を用いた結合フローマッチングによる気液界面の確率的シミュレーション
papers.summary_ja: 気泡流の高精度シミュレーションが計算コストの高い問題に対し、ニューラルサロゲートモデルを提案する。球面調和関数によるコンパクトな表現空間上で、フローマッチングを用いて気泡の軌道と界面変形を同時に予測する。決定論的回帰ではなく条件付き生成問題として扱い、非線形・カオス的な二相流の将来状態を一度に生成する。BubbleSHデータセットでの評価により、DNSソルバーより桁違いに高速でありながら主要な統計特性を再現できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと生成AIによる物理シミュレーション高速化は関心領域と一致

papers.title: GameSmith: Scaling Zero-Sum Self-Play with Synthesised Games
papers.summary: Post-training large language models (LLMs) on two-player zero-sum games provides a verifiable reward, and the gains have been shown to transfer to general reasoning. Existing pipelines, however, rely on a handful of hand-written games and on advantage estimators tied to them, so both the supply of games and the advantage estimate on a large corpus limit scaling. We present GameSmith, which scales both. An LLM synthesises games inside templates whose reward, observation, and hidden-information code is fixed. Each game is verified by seed-paired replay and by an independent re-implementation of its specification, then expanded into encoding, rule, and size variants, giving 26 new games in 29 families and 336 verified variants from the three SPIRAL templates. The model is distilled from the self-play of a larger teacher (Qwen3-32B) on these games and then trained by self-play reinforcement learning with CRAB, an advantage estimator that credits each decision against a shrinkage estimate of the expected return of its position and is defined on every variant. On Qwen3-4B-Base, distillation raises the 13-benchmark mean pass@1 from 45.5 to 62.5, above the three SPIRAL games at the same budget, and self-play with CRAB reaches 64.9. The ordering holds across models, and transfer grows with the number of game families.
papers.title_ja: GameSmith: 合成ゲームを用いたゼロサム自己対戦のスケーリング
papers.summary_ja: LLMの推論能力向上を目的に、ゼロサムゲームにおける自己対戦（Self-Play）による強化学習手法を提案する。従来の手書きゲームに依存する限界を克服するため、LLMがテンプレート内で新しいゲームを自動合成し、検証・バリアント展開を行うパイプラインを構築した。さらに、ポジションの期待リターンに対する収縮推定を用いた新しいアドバンテージ推定器CRABを導入し、より効率的な報酬計算を実現した。Qwen3-4B-Baseモデルにおいて、教師モデルからの蒸留と自己対戦RLにより、13種ベンチマークの平均pass@1を45.5から64.9まで大幅に向上させた。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・強化学習・ベンチマーク評価の全てに関わる

papers.title: VH-GPO: Verified Handoff for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Group-relative reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO train large language model (LLM) agents by comparing rollouts for the same task. When every trajectory in a group fails with the same reward, relative advantages collapse toward zero, leaving no useful learning signal. A frozen teacher can recover from a student-visited state, but letting it complete the task makes the recovered suffix entirely teacher-generated. We ask: after repairing a student failure, when should control return to the student? We propose outcome-verified teacher-student handoff, instantiated in Verified Handoff for Group Policy Optimization (VH-GPO). The teacher provides enough support to reach a state from which the student can succeed, then returns control so that successful experience is again student-generated. Given an environment-verified teacher recovery, VH-GPO selects the earliest independently confirmed handoff point found within a bounded search budget. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, VH-GPO increases success rates over GRPO from 59.38% to 94.79% on ALFWorld and from 71.62% to 77.34% on WebShop. Improvements also hold with the 7B student, for which additional teacher and student output tokens amount to 1.77% and 2.61% of regular student rollout output tokens on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the key components. These results support using verified teacher assistance to repair failures while reinforcing the student's ability to complete tasks independently.
papers.title_ja: VH-GPO: LLMエージェント強化学習における検証済みハンドオフ
papers.summary_ja: GRPOなどのグループ相対強化学習において、全試行が失敗し学習シグナルが消失する問題を解決する手法を提案する。教師モデルが学生モデルの失敗を修復し、学生が独立して成功できる状態まで支援した時点で制御を返す「検証済みハンドオフ」を行う。この手法により、Qwen2.5-1.5BモデルにおいてALFWorldタスクの成功率が59.38%から94.79%へ大幅向上した。追加トークンコストはわずかであり、学生モデルの独立したタスク遂行能力を効率的に強化できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェントの強化学習効率化と実務的改善に直結する手法

papers.title: Artificiality's First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence
papers.summary: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin's Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin's Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin's Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the reference machine and the gap between examiner and examinee. We produce a first battery of certified items administered to twelve LLMs. The resulting agent characteristic curves decrease with difficulty, down to the uncharted high-difficulty region, the supra-intelligence window of items we can certify, yet beyond generations of frontier intelligence.
papers.title_ja: 人工知能の最初の試験：超知能を評価するためのLLM参照Cテスト
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LevinのKt（計算可能なKolmogorov複雑性）に基づき、LLMを参照機械として用いることで、人間や既存のAIが解けない高難度の逆問題（帰納推論）を生成する評価手法を提案する。従来のCテストが限定的な汎用チューリングマシンに依存していたのに対し、本手法はLLMが持つ文化的知識と表現力を活用し、ビット単位の比率尺度で難易度を定量化する。軽量な生成・認証パイプラインを開発し、12種類のLLMに対して検証した結果、難易度が高まるにつれて正答率が低下し、フロンティアモデルの能力を超えた「超知能ウィンドウ」の存在を示唆した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価・ベンチマーク設計と理論的基礎（複雑性理論）の融合

papers.title: Coding LLMs Can Be Harnessed to Learn Interpretable Models from Data
papers.summary: Since compact, interpretable classifiers correspond to simple programs, it is natural to ask if LLM-based coding agents can be used to learn interpretable models from data. In this paper we present a simple harness that repeatedly prompts a coding LLM to produce the next rule in a rule set, given a sample of labeled examples. We show that this approach is competitive with, and often superior to, state-of-the-art rule-learning methods on tabular data, especially with small training sets, and wins by large margins on text, including against another LLM-based rule learner; that this approach outperforms standard harnesses, and that the approach immediately leads to new kinds of interpretable models, since coding agents are not restricted to search a highly restricted hypothesis space. In addition to the advances made in learning interpretable models, these results are of interest because they introduce a new class of coding benchmarks - construction of interpretable classifiers - which includes quantitative measurements of output quality (i.e., test-set error) and existing mature ``specialist coding algorithms'' (i.e., existing learning methods).
papers.title_ja: コーディングLLMを活用したデータからの解釈可能モデルの学習
papers.summary_ja: コーディングLLMをハネスし、ラベル付きデータから解釈可能なルールセットを反復的に生成する手法を提案する。このアプローチは、特に小規模な学習セットやテキストデータにおいて、既存のルール学習手法や他のLLMベース手法を上回る性能を示した。また、コーディングエージェントは仮説空間の制約を受けないため、従来の手法では得られなかった新しい種類の解釈可能モデルを構築できる。さらに、出力品質を定量的に評価できる新しいコーディングベンチマークのクラスとして、既存の専門アルゴリズムとの比較評価も可能である。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM活用、解釈可能性、ベンチマーク評価が関心に合致

papers.title: What Can Language Models Inherit from Solomonoff Induction? Limits, Attainable Properties, and What Served Conditionals Reveal
papers.summary: A familiar line of reasoning runs as follows: language models are flexible approximators trained under a strictly proper loss, so scale brings them closer to Solomonoff induction, and their predictive success is evidence of that approach. We apply known results from algorithmic information theory, universal prediction and Bayesian consistency. In its uniform form the conclusion holds for no computable model: each has cheap environments it never learns, and every uniformly computable family of total predictors shares one on which each member fails beyond a horizon growing with its index, so ``closer'' can hold only pointwise, one environment at a time. Nor could the offered routes certify even that: finite evaluation cannot certify agreement on rarely reached contexts, perfect corpus fit selects the corpus law as prior, and asymptotic criteria cannot see the constants that carry Solomonoff's guarantee. Our lens is the Kraft inequality read for predictors. Every model has at most the same budget of predictive success, so Solomonoff's predictor, which leaves part of it unspent, differs from a language model not in having more of it but in where it spends it; on mutually singular families this is exact, and only full-mass Bayes mixtures reach the frontier. We then discuss what is inheritable, including in-context learning as amortised Bayesian inference; what survives within a context window; which Solomonoff-like properties a deployed system should have or avoid; and what served conditionals determine. A closing table states what common practices certify and what to report. Tests are developed in a companion paper.
papers.title_ja: ソロモフ帰納法から言語モデルは何を継承できるか？限界、達成可能な性質、および提供された条件分岐が示すもの
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、アルゴリズム情報理論とベイズ一貫性の観点から、大規模言語モデル（LLM）がソロモフ帰納法に近づくという主張の理論的限界を分析する。計算可能モデルでは環境ごとに学習失敗が生じるため、スケールアップによる「接近」は点ごとのみ成立し、有限評価やコーパス適合度ではその保証はできないことを示す。クラフト不等式を用いて予測成功の予算配分の違いを定式化し、インコンテキストラーニングを償却ベイズ推論として再解釈する。最後に、実運用システムが持つべきソロモフ的性質や、報告すべき評価指標の具体例を整理している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの理論的限界と評価手法の基礎を深掘りしており、実務的な評価設計に直結する。

papers.title: Beyond a Better Score: Long-Horizon Agentic ML Development and Evaluation Protocol for Physics Time Series
papers.summary: Physics time-series data are central to fundamental discoveries involving dark matter, neutrinos, and gravitational waves. Machine learning has shown strong potential to recover weak scientific signals buried in complex noise. Recent LLM-agent systems further automate ML development, but existing approaches are often driven primarily by one or a few numerical scores. In pursuit of a better score, agents may exploit shortcuts, trigger mode collapse, or game the evaluation procedure, producing models that achieve high scores but are scientifically invalid. We introduce SIDERIUS, an LLM agent system designed to move beyond a better score toward scientifically valid, long-horizon ML development. SIDERIUS combines contract-defined composable capabilities for flexible orchestration and human-in-the-loop, a multi-layer scientific evaluation protocol that distinguishes valid models from unhealthy or gaming models, and resource-aware exploration for computationally expensive scientific ML. In our TIDMAD benchmark, SIDERIUS with a GPT-based orchestrator achieves the highest Valid-model proposal rate of 63.8% and the best valid denoising score of 2.744, compared with 1.6% and -0.647, respectively, for the same GPT model using the general-purpose Codex coding agent. We further benchmark SIDERIUS on three additional physics time-series datasets, demonstrating its reuse and performance across different tasks. Together, these results suggest that progress in agentic scientific ML should be measured beyond a better score, by how an agent explores and by whether the models it produces can be trusted as science.
papers.title_ja: より良いスコアを超えて：物理時系列データ向けの長期エージェント型ML開発と評価プロトコル
papers.summary_ja: 物理時系列データにおけるLLMエージェントによる機械学習開発において、単なるスコア最大化がモデルの科学的無効性や評価ゲーミングを招く問題を指摘する。本研究では、契約定義された機能の組み合わせと多層的な科学的評価プロトコルを備えたエージェントシステム「SIDERIUS」を提案する。SIDERIUSは、GPTベースのオーケストレーターを用いることで、汎用コーディングエージェントと比較し、有効なモデル提案率とノイズ除去性能を大幅に向上させた。さらに、複数の物理時系列データセットでのベンチマークにより、タスク横断的な再利用性と性能を実証している。

papers.title: Contrastive Covariance Subspaces for Activation Steering
papers.summary: Activation steering controls large language model behavior by adding a direction to hidden activations during inference. For steering to work well, that direction must be a pure signal for the target concept: any confound entangled with it, such as an incidental topic or writing style, is injected into the residual stream alongside the concept itself and degrades the generated text. We introduce Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS), a training-free method that eliminates this confound variation. CCS projects steering vectors to a low-dimensional subspace obtained in closed form by solving a contrastive variance objective, which retains the directions along which the target concept varies while suppressing directions shared with the other classes. Across three LLMs and four steering domains, CCS consistently beats all baseline steering methods in all $12$ model-domain settings. The largest relative improvement occurs on AxBench and Emotion where we outperform the next strongest steering baseline by $48$ to $70\%$ and $13$ to $27\%$, respectively. Furthermore, CCS outperforms naive difference-of-means steering by up to $151\%$, showcasing the importance of deconfounding concepts. A toy experiment verifies our motivation on why: planting a topic nuisance into the training data reduces unprojected steering by $46\%$, whereas CCS loses only $12\%$ and recovers most of the gap to an oracle that explicitly deletes the planted direction. A human study with $23$ raters on $296$ generations reproduces the LLM judge's ranking. Our extensive ablation verifies the importance of our method's components and robustness to the number of nuisance classes. Finally, we extend our method to multi-turn conversations, where CCS sustains both concept expression and fluency, matching system prompt performance as other steering methods drift.
papers.title_ja: 活性化ステアリングのための対照共分散部分空間
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の活性化ベクトル操作（ステアリング）において、ターゲット概念と混在するノイズ（トピックや文体など）を除去し、純粋な信号のみを抽出する手法を提案する。対照共分散部分空間（CCS）と呼ばれるこの手法は、学習不要で閉形式解により低次元部分空間へ射影し、概念間の共有方向を抑制する。3つのLLMと4つの領域での実験により、既存のベースラインを大きく上回る性能を示し、特にAxBenchやEmotionタスクで最大70%の改善を達成した。さらに、マルチターン会話における一貫性維持や、人間評価との一致も確認されている。

papers.title: Pick the Mixture, Not the Samples: Combinatorial Data Selection for LLMs
papers.summary: Data selection for LLM fine-tuning faces two facts about real training: data pools draw from many distinct domains, and evaluation spans diverse tasks. As a result, the same sample helps different tasks differently, and samples interact during training so that a subset's value is not the sum of its parts. Current data-selection methods leave these realities largely unaddressed. We formalize them as Combinatorial Data Selection (CDS), a framework that separates attribution (how samples are scored) from selection (which subset to pick) and models the non-additive interactions among samples. On a real instruction-tuning data pool, we find substantial cross-domain complementarity (joint utility exceeds the sum of singletons), alongside redundancy within domains. Inspired by this, we propose Mixture-then-Select, a two-stage algorithm that first decides how many samples to take from each domain, then ranks samples within each domain by attribution score. Theoretically, the gap to the optimal subset is linear in the selection size and independent of data pool size. Empirically, Mixture-then-Select outperforms strong baselines by 20 to 54%, is robust across attribution methods, and works across different models and data pool sizes. The framework also extends to the data purchasing problem under a budget constraint when sample prices vary. Our findings suggest that allocating selection across domains offers a promising path toward more efficient and effective data selection for modern LLMs.
papers.title_ja: サンプルではなく混合比を選ぶ：LLMのための組合せデータ選択
papers.summary_ja: LLMのファインチューニングにおけるデータ選択において、サンプル間の非加法的な相互作用とドメイン間の補完性を考慮する「組合せデータ選択（CDS）」フレームワークを提案する。ドメインごとのサンプル数（混合比）を決定し、その後に個々のサンプルを評価する2段階アルゴリズム「Mixture-then-Select」を設計した。理論的には最適解との差が選択サイズに線形依存し、データプールサイズに依存しないことを示し、実証実験では既存手法より20〜54%の性能向上を達成した。

papers.title: Can We Trust This Evaluation? Instance-Level Reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.summary: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation commonly aggregates multiple judges' decisions into a majority vote, yet this panel decision process does not guarantee that the evaluation of an individual item is reliable. We propose Structured Cross-fitted Uncertainty Risk (SCUR), a label-free approach for estimating instance-level evaluation reliability based on the judge panel's behavior. A latent measurement model serves as the backbone for measurement system analysis, from which SCUR derives three complementary signals capturing panel uncertainty, measurement cross-entropy, and perturbation sensitivity. These three sources of evidence are combined into a risk score. We evaluate the SCUR approach on five real-world benchmarks using majority-vote error ranking, selective trust, and risk stratification. Furthermore, we show our approach to be more effective at detecting high-consensus risk items, which are the blind spots for many other LLM-as-a-judge evaluation methods.
papers.title_ja: この評価は信頼できるか？LLM-as-a-Judgeのインスタンスレベルの信頼性
papers.summary_ja: LLM-as-a-Judge評価における多数決方式では、個々の評価項目の信頼性が保証されない問題に対し、ラベル不要の手法SCURを提案する。潜在測定モデルを基盤に、パネルの不確実性・測定エントロピー・摂動感度からリスクスコアを算出する。5つの実世界ベンチマークで、高コンセンサスリスク項目の検出能力が既存手法より優れていることを示した。

papers.title: Auditing LLM Program Search for Bermudan Stopping with Primal--Dual Certificates
papers.summary: LLM program-search agents are usually judged by the score that drives their search. We study LLM-driven search over Python exercise policies for Bermudan options, an optimal stopping problem where a trusted evaluator owns the simulation and a dual upper bound~$U$. For any policy, $0 \le V^\star - L_\pi \le U - L_\pi$; we report Monte Carlo estimates of both bounds with their sampling error. We audit 24 generation attempts from two pipelines, a six-pair feedback-representation ablation, and a holdout evaluated after selection was frozen. No selected generated program improves on Ridge LSMC consistently or by more than Monte Carlo uncertainty; holdout gap scores lie within $0.002$ of it. On six one-dimensional puts, a high-precision binomial reference places Ridge within Monte Carlo noise of optimal and attributes 99\% of the estimated gap to dual-bound looseness, so this dual audits validity but cannot certify progress at the search's scale. Structured memory showed no benefit over score-only memory in this ablation. Whether search ``worked'' depends on reporting rules: retaining the initial reference, freezing selection before holdout, and counting failures.
papers.title_ja: プライマル・デュアル証明書を用いたバーミュダ型停止問題におけるLLMプログラム検索の監査
papers.summary_ja: LLMによるプログラム検索エージェントがバーミュダ型オプションの最適停止問題を解く過程を、信頼できる評価者とデュアル上界を用いて監査する。24回の生成試行とアブレーション実験の結果、選択された生成プログラムはRidge LSMCを一貫して上回らず、モンテカルロ誤差の範囲内であることが示された。高精度な二項分布参照値との比較により、推定ギャップの99%がデュアル上界の緩さによるものであることが判明し、この手法は妥当性の監査には有効だが、検索スケールでの進歩を証明するには不十分である。また、構造化メモリはスコアのみを保持するメモリと比較して利点を見せなかった。

papers.title: MDN-VJEPA: Multimodal Probabilistic Joint-Embedding World Models
papers.summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn world models by predicting future representations rather than reconstructing observations. Variational JEPA (VJEPA) gives this prediction probabilistic semantics and permits flexible conditional predictive families. We propose MDN-VJEPA, a multimodal probabilistic JEPA that instantiates the latent predictor as a mixture density network (MDN), representing future states with a Gaussian mixture whose components encode alternative futures, their probabilities, and within-mode uncertainty. For sequential prediction, we address two additional structural requirements: multi-modal futures should remain temporally coherent across a trajectory, and predictive beliefs should remain consistent when propagated to the same horizon through different temporal path compositions, as motivated by the Chapman--Kolmogorov equation. Together, these considerations define a three-level hierarchy of multimodal prediction, coherent multimodal trajectories, and compositionally consistent multimodal dynamics. Controlled experiments show that MDN-VJEPA closely recovers known branching predictive laws, that retaining the complete multimodal belief rather than its conditional mean can lead to materially different and substantially better planning decisions under branching futures, and that trajectory-level coupling and distributional consistency improve temporal coherence and multi-horizon agreement. These results support a simple principle: a probabilistic JEPA should preserve not only how uncertain the future is, but which distinct futures constitute that uncertainty, how they form coherent trajectories, and how those beliefs compose through time.
papers.title_ja: MDN-VJEPA: マルチモーダル確率的ジョイント埋め込み世界モデル
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、将来の表現を予測するジョイント埋め込み予測アーキテクチャ（JEPA）の確率拡張であるVJEPAを基盤とし、混合密度ネットワーク（MDN）を用いたマルチモーダル確率的予測モデルMDN-VJEPAを提案する。ガウス混合分布によって将来の状態を表現し、異なる未来の分岐とその確率、モード内不確実性を同時にモデル化する。さらに、時間的な一貫性とチャプマン＝コルモゴロフ方程式に基づく合成整合性を保証する階層構造を導入し、分岐する未来における計画決定の精度向上を実験的に示す。

papers.title: Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.summary: Self-evolving agents improve through repeated cycles of modification and evaluation. However, existing methods receive feedback on modifications only after costly evaluations, and aggregate scores may obscure distinctions between failures that require different repairs. We introduce predictive self-evolution through an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM). Before evaluation, the IDM predicts task-level outcomes of a proposed modification and guides an optional revision. After evaluation, past modifications and their observed outcomes are used to improve the IDM, allowing predictive knowledge to accumulate across generations. The system can thus improve how it solves tasks, proposes modifications, and predicts their effects. Building on HyperAgents, we evaluate this approach across multilingual coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad-level mathematical grading. Our approach outperforms HyperAgents across all four domains, with up to 46% higher average performance over generations. Gains also persist under matched token budgets that include both agent evolution and task evaluation, and extend to held-out tasks. Forecast accuracy improves as the IDM evolves, and the learned predictive knowledge transfers to improve evolution in a new domain.
papers.title_ja: 修正前に予測する：自己進化エージェントのための改善ダイナミクス学習
papers.summary_ja: 自己進化エージェントにおいて、高コストな評価後にのみフィードバックを得る問題に対し、修正前のタスク結果を予測する「改善ダイナミクスモデル（IDM）」を提案する。IDMは過去の修正と結果から学習し、予測に基づいて修正を最適化することで、世代を超えて予測知識を蓄積する。多言語コーディングやロボティクス報酬設計など4つの領域で評価し、既存手法HyperAgentsを上回る性能（最大46%向上）と、トークン予算制約下での持続的な改善を実証した。さらに、学習された予測知識は新しい領域への転移も可能であり、エージェントの進化プロセス自体を高速化・効率化する手法として機能する。

papers.title: Splicing Hints into Reasoning Traces: Learning from Demonstrator Failures
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves mathematical reasoning when a final answer can be checked, but a correct answer does not certify the derivation behind it, and proof problems offer no answer to check. Replacing the check with a reasoning model as an in-loop verifier faces a fundamental obstacle: the policy must already produce occasional correct attempts for any reward to exist, which it may never do at olympiad level. We instead move verification and repair out of the training loop and into offline data generation with SPLICE, a workflow in which a second model, given only a reference solution, edits a reasoning model's traces as they are generated: it verifies progress, truncates a failed trace at its last verified step, and splices in an adaptively strengthened hint until progress resumes. The resulting dataset includes repaired examples whose sampled unaided trajectory failed, with failed continuations removed and progress repeatedly checked against the reference solution. A model finetuned on SPLICE traces outperforms the same model distilled from the reasoning model's unedited traces on AIME and, under a grading protocol validated against human grades, on olympiad proofs. The trained model's own traces show a corresponding behavioral signature: at difficult points it announces a branch in the style of the spliced hints and takes riskier steps, with predictive entropy rising there and just after, a pattern absent from the model trained on unedited traces.
papers.title_ja: 推論トレースへのヒント挿入：デモストレーターの失敗から学ぶ
papers.summary_ja: 検証可能な報酬を用いた強化学習では、最終答えが正しくても導出過程の誤りを検出できない問題がある。本論文は、SPLICE というオフラインデータ生成ワークフローを提案し、参照解を用いて推論モデルのトレースをリアルタイムで検証・修正する。失敗したトレースは最後の検証済みステップで切り詰め、適応的に強化されたヒントを挿入して進行を再開させる。このデータでファインチューニングしたモデルは、AIME やオリンピック数学の証明問題において、未編集トレースから蒸留したモデルを上回る性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の推論能力向上と強化学習手法の改善に直結する

papers.title: PreSO: Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a self-teacher conditioned on privileged information to turn the sparse outcome signal of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) into dense token-level supervision. Yet the teacher's advantage may depend on information unavailable to the student at inference, raising a central question: which privileged changes are worth distilling? We use cross-problem recurrence as an empirical cue for potentially reusable guidance. Comparing the representation shifts induced by full solutions and compact hints, we find that hint-induced shifts are more concentrated and directionally consistent across problems, and yield more sustained downstream gains despite revealing less information. Motivated by this association, we propose Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation (PreSO). At the source, PreSO uses compact hints to limit the solution-specific detail entering the privileged shift. At the target, it estimates a leading low-rank subspace from shifts pooled across related problems, projects the privilege-induced correction onto this subspace, and adds it to the student's unprivileged representation to form the representation-level distillation target. The selected subspace serves as an operational proxy for recurring structure, rather than a guaranteed separation of transferable and instance-specific information. On five competition-level mathematics benchmarks, PreSO consistently outperforms strong baselines across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, improving average accuracy over the base model by 6.8, 9.0, and 10.0 points. Beyond peak accuracy, PreSO attains the highest final-checkpoint average at every model scale, with improvements that persist through the end of training.
papers.title_ja: PreSO: オンポリシー自己蒸留における特権表現の分離
papers.summary_ja: オンポリシー自己蒸留（OPSD）において、教師モデルが持つ推論時に利用できない特権情報（完全な解答など）から、学生モデルが学習すべき再利用可能な構造を分離する手法を提案する。完全な解答ではなくコンパクトなヒントによる表現シフトの方が問題間で一貫性があり、下流タスクでの性能向上が持続的であることを実証した。これに基づき、関連する複数問題から得られた表現シフトの低ランク部分空間を推定し、その方向性のみを学生モデルの表現に投影して蒸留ターゲットとする。5つの数学ベンチマークにおいて、Qwen3シリーズの各サイズでベースラインを上回り、最終チェックポイントでの精度向上が持続することを示した。

papers.title: CoEvoke: Evoking Multi-Agent Collaboration for Trajectory Collection
papers.summary: Training multi-agent collaboration requires trajectories of checking, feedback, and repair, yet task-solving rollouts may end in immediate approval or repeat unsuccessful attempts without useful correction. We introduce CoEvoke, a cross-domain framework that evokes these interactions during trajectory collection. Controlled perturbations create recoverable difficulties, while restricted reference-based guidance directs investigation. The resulting dataset contains 4,567 reconstructable trajectories over 4,130 software-engineering and reasoning tasks, linking public interactions to evidence, decisions, and task-native outcomes. Separate experiments over 2,287 same-task pairs show feedback increases of 47.72-100 percentage points across seven perturbation groups; guidance has smaller, model-dependent effects. With identical training tasks, decision-record counts, and updates, perturbation-enriched judge training improves ACPBench-Hard success from 35.38% to 42.12% (+6.73 points). SWE verifier training gains 7.60-9.40 points over interface-matched untrained references. Workflow and post-training evaluations preserve task-solving topology with unperturbed inputs and no private-reference guidance. These results support designing collection conditions to obtain corrective supervision that improves collaborative decisions with frozen solving agents.
papers.title_ja: CoEvoke: 軌道収集のためのマルチエージェント協調の喚起
papers.summary_ja: マルチエージェント協調の学習において、チェック・フィードバック・修復を含む有用な軌道（trajectory）が得にくい問題を解決するフレームワーク「CoEvoke」を提案する。制御された摂動により回復可能な困難を作り出し、制限付きの参照ベースのガイダンスによって調査を誘導することで、ソフトウェアエンジニアリングや推論タスクにおける4,567件の再構築可能な軌道を収集した。実験では、フィードバックの増加が47.72〜100ポイントに達し、摂動を豊富にしたジャッジモデルの訓練によりACPBench-Hardの成功率が35.38%から42.12%へ向上した。この手法は、凍結された解決エージェントを用いながら、協調的な意思決定を改善するための補正監督信号を効率的に得ることを可能にする。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と軌道データ収集の効率化に直結する手法

papers.title: OPMD: On-Policy Mechanism Distillation Beyond Output Supervision
papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model by supervising a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy, but its supervision remains confined to the output space. Consequently, OPD transfers what a teacher predicts without supervising the intermediate computation that produces those predictions. Simply distilling intermediate representations like representation matching is insufficient since teacher and student representations may differ geometrically, and even well-aligned hidden states need not be usable by the student's subsequent computation. We introduce On-Policy Mechanism Distillation (OPMD), which transfers teacher-derived intermediate computation while explicitly accounting for its compatibility with the student. OPMD first constructs a student-compatible teacher that transforms teacher representations into intermediate states usable by the student's downstream computation, then it internalizes these states from on-policy trajectories. OPMD achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated distillation baselines in all three teacher--student settings, and generalizes to multi-teacher distillation and cross-family supervised fine-tuning. Further analyses show that mechanism supervision yields more effective reasoning and meaningfully alters the student's intermediate computation and solution strategies, supporting that it transfers information beyond output supervision alone. Together, these results establish mechanism-level supervision as an effective way to move on-policy distillation beyond output supervision, enabling students to learn inner mechanisms they can use and internalize.
papers.title_ja: OPMD: 出力監督を超えたオンポリシー機構蒸留
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、教師モデルの中間計算過程を学生モデルに転移する「オンポリシー機構蒸留（OPMD）」を提案する。従来の出力空間でのみ行われる蒸留では、教師と学生の表現が幾何学的に異なるため中間層の直接転移が困難だが、OPMDは学生の下流計算と互換性のある教師表現を構築し、オンポリシー軌道から内部化させる。これにより、評価された蒸留ベースラインの中で最も高い平均精度を達成し、マルチ教師蒸留やクロスファミリーのファインチューニングにも汎化することが示された。機構レベルの監督は、学生モデルの推論能力を高め、出力監督だけでは得られない内部メカニズムの学習を可能にする。

papers.title: A Geometric Perspective on Reward Function Updates in Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) is classically solved using Lagrangian optimisation, by jointly optimising a primal-dual problem with gradient descent to obtain the optimal reward function parameters and corresponding optimal policy. While this algorithmic view of IRL has been highly influential, gradient-based reward updates only paint a partial picture, largely ignoring the geometry of the problem in occupancy space. In this paper, we present an occupancy-space view of reward updates in IRL. We leverage the insight that both the optimal solution and its geometry in occupancy space are known, and show that the geometry along the e-geodesic (straight line in occupancy space) toward the optimal occupancy directly affects the gradient of the IRL dual problem in reward parameter space. This perspective naturally suggests preconditioning the dual gradient with the average Fisher information along the occupancy trajectory. We show that this preconditioned gradient is just a convex interpolation of the old reward and a new target reward, yielding efficient natural-gradient-style updates with little additional computational overhead. We then analyse these occupancy-space reward updates from a Mirror Descent (MD) perspective, and show that policy search over the resulting rewards induces approximate entropic MD on the policy. Finally, we conclude with convergence results of such geometry-aware IRL algorithms.
papers.title_ja: 逆強化学習における報酬関数更新の幾何学的視点
papers.summary_ja: 逆強化学習（IRL）における報酬関数の更新を、占有率空間の幾何学的構造に基づいて再解釈する。最適解への経路に沿った平均フィッシャー情報量を用いた事前条件付けにより、計算コストを抑えた効率的な自然勾配型更新則を導出する。さらに、この更新がミラー降下法（Mirror Descent）の観点から、ポリシー空間における近似的エントロピー付きMDに相当することを示す。最後に、この幾何学的に意識したIRLアルゴリズムの収束性を理論的に分析している。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習の手法全般および最適化理論への深い洞察を含むため

papers.title: Interpretable Graph Partitioning for Spatial Prediction
papers.summary: Spatial prediction estimates unobserved values from spatially distributed observations. Although flexible predictive models are increasingly available, their practical use remains limited when interpretability is essential. In this study, we formulate a graph partitioning problem to construct a global surrogate model that approximates black-box predictions with simpler representations. Specifically, we select connected subgraphs to minimize within-cluster residuals in vertex-level predictions. Although this formulation can be viewed as a variant of spatial regionalization, it operates on model-based predictions at individual locations rather than predefined areal units. With many locations, this point-level formulation may produce artificial connections between regions, reducing interpretability. We therefore introduce a constraint that excludes such connections while retaining flexible partition boundaries. We theoretically analyze how this constraint affects the resulting partition. We also develop a computational procedure for adjusting partition boundaries. Experimental results show that the proposed method yields spatially coherent partitions with flexible boundaries.
papers.title_ja: 空間予測のための解釈可能なグラフ分割
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、ブラックボックスモデルの予測を単純な表現で近似するグローバルサロゲートモデルの構築を、グラフ分割問題として定式化する。頂点レベルの予測におけるクラスター内残差を最小化することで、空間的に一貫性のある柔軟な境界を持つ分割を実現する。また、人工的な地域間接続を排除する制約を導入し、その理論的性質と計算手順を分析した。実験により、解釈可能性を損なわずに空間予測の精度と可視化を両立させる手法であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと空間予測の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: PLDiv: Measuring Dataset Diversity and Semantic Collapse via Persistence Landscapes
papers.summary: Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. Whether measuring intrinsic diversity in text generations or image embeddings, or detecting semantic collapse in instruction datasets and reasoning trajectories, PLDiv performs competitively against evaluated baselines and aligns strongly with diversity labels during semantic collapse. Consequently, it effectively supports applications in synthetic data monitoring, dataset construction, data augmentation, and generative model evaluation.
papers.title_ja: PLDiv: 持続ランドスケープを用いたデータセットの多様性とセマンティックコラプスの測定
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、持続ランドスケープ（トポロジー解析手法）に基づいた新しいデータセット多様性指標「PLDiv」を提案する。従来の語彙的バリエーションやエントロピーベースの指標とは異なり、データ分布の幾何学的構造と近傍関係の進化を定量化することで、タスク特異的な教師信号なしで構造的な多様性を解釈可能なスカラー値として表現する。テキスト生成や画像埋め込み、指示データセットにおけるセマンティックコラプス検出において、既存ベースラインと競合する性能を示し、多様性ラベルとの強い相関を確認した。合成データ監視、データセット構築、データ拡張、生成モデル評価など、LLMや生成AIのパイプラインにおけるデータ品質管理に応用可能である。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMデータ品質・評価手法に関わるため関連度が高い

papers.title: Residual Compliant Policy: Learning Compliant Policies from Few Demonstrations
papers.summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires a robot to be precise in free space to establish the intended contacts, and compliant once in contact to avoid excessive forces. Imitation learning has proven effective for simpler manipulation tasks, but the compliance underlying a demonstration is not directly observable and is therefore difficult to infer from demonstration data alone. We present a framework that makes compliance explicit at every stage. During data collection, the operator teleoperates the real robot while a synchronized digital twin visualizes the error between the commanded reference and the achieved pose, making the current compliance visible, and selects between two discrete compliance modes. To generalize across object poses, we combine Laplacian editing, which retargets trajectories efficiently but is not physics-consistent during contact, with simulation-based trajectory optimization, which enforces physical plausibility but offers no manual guidance. Finally, a residual reinforcement learning policy refines the interaction forces by adjusting the reference pose of the underlying admittance controller. We evaluate on three flipping and pushing tasks on a Franka FR3 based on a total of 7 demonstrations across tasks. Our method is successful on all 40 out-of-distribution trials, compared to 33/40 and 24/40 for two baselines, with our base policy alone reaching 35/40.
papers.title_ja: 残差コンプライアンスポリシー：少数のデモからコンプライアンスポリシーを学習する
papers.summary_ja: 接触を伴うマニピュレーションにおいて、デモデータから直接観測できないコンプライアンス（柔軟性）を明示的に学習するフレームワークを提案する。デジタルツインを用いたテレオペレーションでコンプライアンスモードを可視化・選択し、ラプラシアン編集とシミュレーションベースの軌道最適化を組み合わせることで、物理的一貫性と汎化性を両立させる。さらに、残差強化学習ポリシーによりアミッタンス制御の参照姿勢を微調整し、接触時の力を最適化する。Franka FR3を用いた3タスクの検証において、わずか7回のデモから40回の分布外試行すべてで成功し、ベースラインを上回る性能を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と制御の融合だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化とは無関係

papers.title: Akule: Fast and Scalable Multi-Robot Motion Planning via Sparse Interaction Diffusion
papers.summary: Diffusion models provide expressive trajectory priors for multi-robot motion planning (MRMP), but scaling them to large teams requires coordinating individual motions without expensive joint computation. We introduce Akule, a sparse interaction diffusion framework that augments a frozen single-robot prior with three learned modules: a reusable pairwise correction model $R_{\phi}$, a contextual selector $U_{\psi}$ that determines which corrections to evaluate, and a composer $G_{\omega}$ that combines their effects through context-dependent signed weights. This decomposition separates which interactions merit computation from how their effects should be combined into coordinated denoising updates. We train $R_{\phi}$ using matched pairwise trajectory optimizations, then learn $G_{\omega}$ and $U_{\psi}$ from physically optimized joint trajectories without requiring a prescribed ground-truth interaction graph. The resulting joint proposals are passed to a downstream search-based planner for validation and repair. Across diverse MRMP benchmarks, Akule achieves competitive planning success, complete-planner speedups of up to $25\times$, zero-shot population transfer, and successful planning with up to $256$ robots. Ablations further demonstrate that learned selection and composition reduce pre-repair conflicts and downstream repair effort relative to heuristic selection and uniform summation.
papers.title_ja: Akule: 疎相互作用拡散による高速かつスケーラブルなマルチロボット運動計画
papers.summary_ja: マルチロボット運動計画において、凍結された単一ロボット事前分布に疎相互作用モジュールを追加することで、大規模チームの協調動作を効率的に生成するフレームワーク「Akule」を提案する。ペアワイズ補正モデル、文脈選択器、コンポーザーの3つの学習済みモジュールを用い、計算コストの高い連合計算を回避しつつ、物理的に最適化された軌道から相互作用グラフなしで学習する。この手法により、最大256台のロボットで計画に成功し、完全なプランナーと比較して最大25倍の高速化を実現した。さらに、ゼロショットでの集団転移や、下流の探索ベースプランナーによる検証・修復プロセスとの統合も示されている。
papers.relevance_reason: 拡散モデルとエージェント設計の応用だが、対象が宇宙軌道ではなくロボット

papers.title: ATTCK-R: Knowledge-Aware Long-Horizon Jailbreaking for Protected LLMs
papers.summary: As large language models are deployed behind increasingly sophisticated safety mechanisms, evaluating their robustness under realistic adversarial conditions becomes increasingly difficult and critical. Existing jailbreaking evaluations often rely on static prompts, limited interaction horizons, or lightly protected systems, failing to reflect protected deployment settings with prompt-based safety protections. We show that the introduction of a prompt-based safety protection reduces the average attack success rate of a strong multi-turn baseline from 0.896 to 0.608 (32.1\% relative), demonstrating that unprotected evaluations substantially overestimate real-world vulnerabilities. We propose Adaptive Traceback and Tactic Curation for Knowledge-based Red-teaming (ATTCK-R), a planning-driven multi-turn red teaming framework designed for protected black-box systems. ATTCK-R models jailbreaking as a long-horizon trajectory optimization problem using a structured belief state, introduces optimization-based tactic curation to abstract reusable strategies from prior successes and failures, and employs informed traceback to resume attacks from strategically meaningful states rather than restarting. Evaluated across 9 widely used LLMs configured with a single prompt-based safety protection layer, ATTCK-R consistently outperforms strong recent multi-turn jailbreaking frameworks. Ablation results confirm that long-horizon planning and tactic curation improve attack effectiveness, while adaptive traceback improves efficiency through structured recovery from conversational failure.
papers.title_ja: ATTCK-R: 保護されたLLMに対する知識認識型長期 Jailbreaking
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、プロンプトベースの安全保護を備えたブラックボックスLLMに対する、計画駆動型のマルチターン・レッドチーミングフレームワーク「ATTCK-R」を提案する。Jailbreakingを長期軌道最適化問題としてモデル化し、構造化された信念状態を用いることで、過去の成功・失敗から再利用可能な戦略を抽出する最適化ベースの戦術キュレーションを実現した。また、対話の失敗時に戦略的に意味のある状態から攻撃を再開する適応型トレースバックにより、効率性を向上させている。9つのLLMでの評価により、既存の強力なマルチターン手法を上回る攻撃成功率と、保護下での脆弱性評価の重要性を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM評価手法と強化学習的計画手法を含むが、軌道力学や効率化とは無関係

papers.title: Distributed Observation Scheduling and Sensor Fusion For Large Agile Constellations
papers.summary: With the rapid increase in interest towards large scale earth observing satellite constellations, the problem of properly commanding and utilizing these systems has become increasingly relevant. This work focuses on a complete distributed approach to this problem, incorporating an observation task allocation and scheduling algorithm in addition to a sensor data fusion algorithm for end-to-end target coverage and processing. Observation task allocation and scheduling is performed in this work through the combination of the bid warped consensus based bundle algorithm (BWCBBA) and a lightweight observation scheduler for bid scoring. This method produces a unique mapping of tasks to command agents when allowed to iterate sufficiently. The approach to distributed data fusion in this work occurs primarily through an ownership model in which one satellite takes ownership of a system track in the constellation. After local information is shared between the sensing nodes to create the system tracks, the dedicated fusion nodes assume ownership for further information fusion and track information is disseminated throughout the constellation for data association. This paper analyzes the performance of these two algorithms over a set of increasingly decentralized architectures to highlight the performance losses compared to more traditional centralized methods.
papers.title_ja: 大規模アジャイル衛星コンステレーションのための分散型観測スケジューリングとセンサーフュージョン
papers.summary_ja: 大規模な地球観測衛星コンステレーションにおける、分散型のアプローチによる観測タスク割当・スケジューリングとセンサーデータフュージョン手法を提案する。タスク割当には、入札ベースのコンセンサスアルゴリズム（BWCBBA）と軽量なスケジューラを組み合わせて、エージェントへの一意なタスクマッピングを実現する。データフュージョンでは、軌道追跡の所有権モデルを用い、専用ノードが情報融合を担当することで、分散環境下でも効率的なターゲットカバレッジと処理を行う。中央集権型手法と比較し、分散アーキテクチャの性能劣化を分析している。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学やML手法そのものではなく、衛星コンステレーションの制御・スケジューリングが主眼のため

papers.title: Belief Space Planning for Risk Signal Temporal Logic via Mixed-Integer Convex Programming
papers.summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifies robot tasks with spatio-temporal requirements, and its robustness semantics allow planning by trajectory optimization. In practice, robots estimate their state from noisy measurements, and when the information gained from a measurement depends on the state, the robot can actively reduce its uncertainty by planning in the belief space. The resulting problem is, however, generally non-convex, for which gradient-based methods are neither complete nor globally optimal. In this paper, we consider Risk STL (RiSTL) planning in Gaussian belief space and show that an information-form parameterization of the belief, together with a convex relaxation of the belief dynamics, yields a mixed-integer convex program (MICP). We prove that the MICP is sound and complete, and that the relaxation preserves the globally optimal input trajectories. We validate the effectiveness of our method in numerical simulations.
papers.title_ja: 混合整数凸計画によるリスクシグナル時間論理を用いた信念空間計画
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、ノイズのある観測下でロボットが不確実性を能動的に低減するための信念空間計画手法を提案する。ガウス信念空間における情報形式のパラメータ化と信念ダイナミクスの凸緩和を用いることで、問題を混合整数凸計画（MICP）として定式化することを示した。このMICPが健全かつ完全であり、緩和がグローバル最適解を保持することを証明している。数値シミュレーションにより、この手法の有効性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 凸最適化と確率推定は関連するが、軌道力学やLLMへの直接適用性は低い

papers.title: SIRNET: Causal Adaptation of Pretrained Embeddings for Semiparametric Treatment-Effect Estimation Under Surrogacy
papers.summary: Modern experiments increasingly produce rich post-treatment objects---such as text, images, and video---that may provide early surrogate signals for outcomes that are delayed, expensive, or observed only for a subset of participants. A pretrained encoder can turn such an object into a strong generic embedding, but the embedding is not trained for the estimation tasks required by a causal estimator and may emphasize information irrelevant to the causal target. We propose SIRNET, a Surrogate-Informed Representation adaptation framework for neural-NETwork-based causal estimation in the presence of unstructured post-treatment surrogates. Starting from pretrained surrogate embeddings, SIRNET learns a shared adapter jointly for outcome prediction, treatment propensity, and arm-specific surrogate marginalization, beyond the generic pretraining objective. The resulting covariate and surrogate representations provide a common interface for these nuisance tasks. The final treatment-effect estimate and confidence interval are obtained from cross-fitted orthogonal scores that attain the semiparametric efficiency bound under the stated nuisance-rate conditions. We also validate SIRNET's performance in synthetic and semisynthetic experiments, as well as the Anti-Amyloid in Asymptomatic Alzheimer's Disease (A4) trial, using frozen pretrained brain-MRI embeddings as surrogates for a long-term outcome.
papers.title_ja: SIRNET: サロゲート下における半パラメトリック治療効果推定のための事前学習埋め込みの因果的適応
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、テキストや画像などの非構造化データをサロゲート変数として利用し、遅延する結果に対する治療効果を推定するフレームワーク「SIRNET」を提案する。事前学習済みエンコーダの埋め込みを起点とし、結果予測・治療傾向・サロゲート周辺化のタスクに合わせてアダプタを共同学習することで、因果推定に特化した表現を獲得する。最終的な効果推定は交差適合直交スコアを用い、半パラメトリック効率限界を達成する。合成データおよびアルツハイマー病の臨床試験データを用いた検証により、凍結した脳MRI埋め込みから長期結果を推定する有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと深層学習の組み合わせだが、宇宙工学やLLM効率化とは無関係

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Hybrid Forward-Inverse Machine Learning Framework for High-Dimensional Sparse Recipe Reconstruction
papers.summary: High-dimensional sparse recipe formulation in process industries involves nonlinear association of various covariates, bounded by sparsity constraints and multi-criteria tolerances. Traditional physics-based classical methods (such as Kubelka-Munk) fail to generate sparse candidate recipes properly due to their simplified assumptions and industrial process variations. This study proposes a hybrid physics-informed uncertainty-aware framework that is structured into three modules: (a) Module A, a multi-target forward quality model; (b) Module B, a sparse inverse reconstructor; and (c) Module C, a feasibility-constrained ranking layer. Then it has been validated in an industrial textile dyeing context with recipe-grouped cross-validation under multi-illuminant quality assessment comprising process and production information, target reflectance, K/S values, and spectral descriptors. Histogram Gradient Boosting (HGB) with spectral-only features ($R_\lambda$, K/S) and Gradient Boosting Regressor (GBDT) with recipe-process features outperforms other configurations with out-of-Fold MAE of 0.1655 and 0.1523 in the forward quality model. For inverse reconstruction, a component-wise median blend achieved a recipe-vector MAE of 0.0295. Exploratory conditional treatment effect (CATE) suggests an observational association that alkali adjustment reduces error for red and pale shades (CATE = -0.196). This framework provides a human-in-the-loop decision-support tool that minimizes costly laboratory trials across industrial formulation domains.
papers.title_ja: 高次元スパースレシピ再構築のための物理情報ハイブリッド順・逆機械学習フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、産業プロセスにおける高次元スパースな配合（レシピ）設計を支援する、物理情報と不確実性を考慮したハイブリッドフレームワークを提案する。マルチターゲット順方向品質モデル、スパース逆方向再構築器、制約付きランキング層からなる3つのモジュールで構成され、伝統的な物理ベース手法の限界を克服する。産業用染色プロセスでの検証において、ヒストグラム勾配ブースティング（HGB）や勾配ブースティング回帰（GBDT）を用いた順方向モデルが高精度な予測を実現し、逆方向再構築では成分ごとの中央値ブレンドが有効であった。この手法は、コストのかかる実験回数を削減する人間とAIの協調意思決定ツールとして機能する。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報MLと逆問題解決の手法は関連するが、対象が染色レシピであり軌道力学ではないため

papers.title: Embodied Zero-Shot Task Planning via Hardware-Aware LLM-VLM Integration for Grounded Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: Large language models can translate natural-language instructions into plausible manipulation plans, but robotic execution requires physically grounded decisions that respect robot embodiment, workspace geometry, reachability, collision constraints, and grasp feasibility. This paper presents a hardware-aware large language model-vision-language model (LLM-VLM) manipulation framework for a simulated Franka Research 3 robot in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The framework separates symbolic reasoning from metric execution: an API-hosted LLM planner receives a structured scene summary and generates only symbolic task information, including the object to manipulate, target relation, approach preference, and objects to avoid. A local Qwen3-VL 8B VLM verifier supports semantic confirmation of ambiguous objects and open-container surrogates. Both the LLM planner and the VLM verifier are prohibited from generating robot coordinates, grasp poses, keepout dimensions, gripper commands, trajectory waypoints, or success labels. Instead, these decisions are handled by deterministic grounding and execution modules that use the robot model, scene geometry, MoveIt 2 collision checking, inverse kinematics, grasp validation, release verification, and final visual assessment. Execution feedback is returned only as symbolic context for replanning. The framework is evaluated through simulated digital-twin trials involving pickup, occluded-source access, keepout reasoning, relation placement, and sequential manipulation tasks.
papers.title_ja: ハードウェア認識型LLM-VLM統合による具現化ゼロショットタスク計画と根拠付けられたロボティック操作
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMとVLMを統合したハードウェア認識型フレームワークを提案し、シミュレーション環境でのロボティック操作におけるゼロショットタスク計画を実現する。LLMは記号的なタスク情報のみを生成し、座標や把持姿勢などの物理的決定は決定論的なグラウンディングモジュールが担当することで、物理的制約を厳密に満たす。Qwen3-VL 8Bによる検証とMoveIt 2を用いた衝突チェックを通じて、曖昧なオブジェクトの識別や安全な操作を確保する。この分離設計により、自然言語指示から物理的に実行可能な操作計画への信頼性の高い変換が可能となる。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計とRAG的要素を含むが、対象がロボット操作であり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Softmax-Free Attention in Spiking Transformers as the Zero-Temperature Limit of Two-Level Systems
papers.summary: Spiking Transformers achieve energy efficiency by discarding softmax normalization in favor of thresholded, binary attention. However, this removal breaks the thermodynamic framework used to analyze attention networks, as the normalized measure and partition function cease to exist. We restore this theoretical foundation by proving that softmax-free spiking attention operates exactly as the zero-temperature limit of a product of independent two-level systems. This correspondence places spiking attention strictly in the frozen ordered phase of the thermodynamic phase diagram for all inputs. Consequently, the entropic cost of organizing attention collapses, replaced by a Landauer-type physical floor governed by action-potential generation. Furthermore, this ordered-phase pinning mathematically explains the optimization difficulty caused by vanishing surrogate gradients. We validate this theory with forward-relaxation experiments, placing both standard and neuromorphic attention mechanisms on a unified thermodynamic axis.
papers.title_ja: スパイキングトランスフォーマーにおけるSoftmaxフリーアテンション：二準位系のゼロ温度極限としての解釈
papers.summary_ja: スパイキングトランスフォーマーでSoftmax正規化を除去した際の熱力学的枠組みの欠如を解決するため、本論文はこれが独立した二準位系の積のゼロ温度極限に厳密に対応することを証明した。この対応により、スパイキングアテンションは入力に対して常に凍結した秩序相にあることが示され、エントロピーコストが消失し、代わりにLandauer限界が支配する物理的床が置かれる。さらに、この秩序相の固定が、消失するサロゲート勾配による最適化の困難さを数学的に説明する。標準的なアテンションとニューロモルフィックアテンションを統一された熱力学的軸上で検証する実験も行った。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と関連するが、対象がスパイキングNNと熱力学理論に特化

papers.title: PsyBer-Agent: A Psychology-Driven User Agent for Recommender Systems
papers.summary: Evaluating recommender systems before deployment requires simulators that remain realistic over long, closed-loop interaction cycles. Current LLM-based agents generally function as surface imitators that generate realistic short-term responses but fail to capture the underlying user dynamics such as fatigue, affect, and shifting preferences. We propose PsyBer-Agent, a psychology-inspired simulator that models these dynamics through its Psy-Engine. This engine represents each user with three evolving, model-defined latent states. To calibrate simulated behavior against real interaction logs, we align log-conditioned reference trajectories with simulator-generated latent-state trajectories via Unbalanced Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport. This approach provides structured supervision for a lightweight policy without the computational burden of fine-tuning the backbone LLM. We also introduce WebSim and the PsyBer Benchmark, which encompass multimodal scenarios and seven recommender backbones. Our framework evaluates behavioral fidelity, latent-state consistency, robustness, and responses to social-cue perturbations. On the tested horizons, PsyBer-Agent shows lower behavioral discrepancy than the prompt-only simulators while maintaining stable performance under large-scale concurrent simulation for up to 5M queued simulation tasks under bounded concurrency. Code is available in the supplementary material and at: PsyBer-Agent: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CC66F/, WebSim Platform: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/D8EAX/.
papers.title_ja: PsyBer-Agent: 推薦システムのための心理学駆動型ユーザーエージェント
papers.summary_ja: LLMベースのシミュレーターが短期的な反応の模倣に留まる問題を解決するため、疲労や感情変化などの潜在状態をモデル化する心理学インスパイア型エージェントを提案する。実データとの整合性を高めるため、非平衡Gromov-Wasserstein最適輸送を用いて潜在状態の軌道をアラインし、バックボーンLLMのファインチューニングなしで軽量なポリシーを学習する。さらに、マルチモーダルシナリオを含むWebSimプラットフォームとベンチマークを構築し、大規模並列シミュレーション下での安定性と行動の忠実性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法に関わるが、推薦システム特化で軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: SemTree: Judge-Aware Semantic Decision Trees for Inspectable and Repairable Rule Decisions
papers.summary: Rule decisions such as content moderation, advertising compliance, and eligibility checks combine several conditions, exemptions, and missing-information cases, and an error can be fixed only once the failing condition is known. We introduce SemTree, a framework that represents a rule decision as a semantic decision tree: each node is a natural-language question with explicit Yes/No/Unknown criteria, a pluggable semantic judge answers it, and the branching structure is compiled on the answers that this judge actually gives. The executed path is the reasoning behind every decision, so errors are repaired where they occur: a reviewer corrects a single node and replays the rule, corrected nodes become training labels for the judge, and a tool-using LLM editor revises questions and subtrees while observing execution results. On all 8,276 ShARC test cases, a tree executed by a hosted judge reaches 67.70% accuracy with 2.99 questions per case, on par with asking the same judge for the final label (68.23%); an earlier tree compiled for a different judge scores 47.87% when executed by this judge, while a new tree compiled on this judge's answers to a 12-question initial pool already scores 64.39%. Node-level repair raises BANKING77 accuracy from 82.04% to 86.16%, an explicit exemption node cuts the false positives of a Chinese e-commerce moderation clause from 24 to 5, and a trained editor raises the development accuracy of edited trees from 64.47% to 73.35%.
papers.title_ja: SemTree: 検査可能かつ修復可能なルール決定のためのジャッジ認識型セマンティック決定木
papers.summary_ja: コンテンツモデレーションなどのルール決定を、自然言語の質問とYes/No/Unknown基準を持つセマンティック決定木として表現するフレームワークを提案する。実行パスが推論過程となるため、エラー発生時に特定ノードのみを修正・再実行することで効率的に修復可能であり、修正済みノードはジャッジの学習ラベルとして活用される。ShARCテストケースでは最終ラベル直接判定と同等の精度を達成し、BANKING77や中国ECのモデレーションにおいてノードレベルの修復や例外ノードの追加により精度向上と誤検知削減を実証した。

papers.title: When Log Parsing Removes What Matters: Detecting Failures in Distributed GPU Workloads
papers.summary: Large AI models increasingly rely on distributed GPU execution, yet it remains unclear whether established failure analysis methods transfer effectively to this setting. We introduce GF-Bench, a PyTorch-based framework and dataset for generating diverse failures in distributed GPU workloads. The framework supports extensible workload and fault-injection logic; based on this design, the current release targets failures visible in multi-GPU communication logs and provides 220 labeled two-GPU executions covering normal runs, CUDA out-of-memory fail-stop failures, and persistent straggler fail-slow failures. Using GF-Bench, we evaluate three sequence-based methods (DeepLog, LogAnomaly, and LogBERT) and the LLM-based LogPrompt on parsed logs, and additionally evaluate LogPrompt on raw logs. On parsed inputs, no method reliably detects both failure classes, and the highest overall F1 score is 0.667. Raw inputs raise the overall F1 score of in-context LogPrompt to 0.983, at 9.0x its average input-token usage and 8.7x its per-run cost. These results expose a substantial trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency: generic log parsing lowers operational cost but discards the distributed execution context required for accurate failure detection. GF-Bench provides a reproducible basis for studying cost-efficient analysis methods and can be extended to additional GPU workloads and failure types.
papers.title_ja: ログ解析が重要情報を削除する場合：分散GPUワークロードにおける障害検出
papers.summary_ja: 分散GPU環境での障害検出において、既存のログ解析手法が有効かを評価するベンチマークGF-Benchを提案する。DeepLogやLogBERTなどのシーケンスベース手法とLLMベースのLogPromptを比較し、パース済みログでは検出精度が低く、生ログを用いると精度は向上するが計算コストが大幅に増加することを示した。この結果は、効率性と検出精度のトレードオフを浮き彫りにし、コスト効率の良い分析方法の研究基盤を提供する。

papers.title: Rotate the Loop: Blockwise Conformality for Looped Transformers
papers.summary: Looped transformers reuse one shared block across many recurrent steps, so depth becomes a quantity that can be spent at runtime rather than a stack of distinct layers. Those extra steps help only if a write made on one recurrent step is still readable on later ones, and that depends on the linear map applied to the residual between recurrent steps. We show that whether the loop learns to track state is a geometric question about the form of this map, and we propose blockwise conformal injections: the residual splits into coordinate-aligned groups and rotates inside each one, so every group has its own timescale while the geometry stays exact within it. Our experiments show a performance increase on a demanding form of state tracking - last-token accuracy when the rest of the prefix is already correct - and on language modelling, where a signal written earlier has to be retrieved at the end of the sequence.
papers.title_ja: ループを回転させる：ループ型Transformerにおけるブロック単位保角性
papers.summary_ja: ループ型Transformerでは、共有ブロックを反復的に適用することで実行時の深さを可変化するが、状態追跡の精度は残差接続間の線形写像の幾何学的性質に依存する。本論文では、この写像が座標軸に沿ったグループ内で回転する「ブロック単位保角注入」であることを提案し、各グループに固有の時間スケールを持たせつつ幾何学的正確性を保つ手法を提示する。実験により、この手法が厳密な状態追跡タスクや言語モデリングにおける長距離依存性の処理性能を向上させることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMアーキテクチャの効率化と推論性能向上に関わる手法であるため

papers.title: Does System One Transfer? Calibrated Typed-Decision Models, Label Budgets, and Translation for Indonesian Regional Languages
papers.summary: Calibrated typed-decision ("System One") models return a label and a probability in a single forward pass at a small fraction of the cost of large language models (LLMs), yet their evaluation has been almost entirely English. We report a pre-registered evaluation of the commercial Jev model and the open Laya-multilingual model on Indonesian regional languages, using the parallel NusaX sentiment (12 languages) and NusaTranslation sentiment and emotion (7 languages) test sets. Jev is more often correct on sentences that are lexically closer to Indonesian in all three datasets, and presenting the human Indonesian translation instead raises its accuracy by up to 37.2 points, most in languages distant from Indonesian. Its expected calibration error does not grow on regional languages, but its ability to rank its own errors degrades in all three datasets. Retrained classifiers need more than 500 labels per language to match zero-shot Jev in 9 of 10 NusaX regional languages. A confidence-gated cascade that sends Jev's 10-30% least confident decisions to a local IndoBERT classifier matches or exceeds the better of the two systems, and routing to an LLM instead matches that LLM at 24-77% lower API cost. Of six further commercial LLMs (three Claude and three GPT models), five are 4-14 points more accurate than Jev, at several hundred times the API cost where it is reported, while the smallest (Claude Haiku) is less accurate. We release the pre-registration, code and all predictions.
papers.title_ja: システム1は転移するか？インドネシア地域言語における較正済み型付き決定モデル、ラベル予算、および翻訳
papers.summary_ja: LLMの低コスト代替手段である較正済み型付き決定モデル（System One）の性能を、インドネシア地域言語の感情分析タスクで評価した。Jevモデルはインドネシア語に近い言語で高精度だが、信頼度による誤りランキング能力は低下する傾向がある。再学習分類器はゼロショットのJevに匹敵するために言語あたり500以上のラベルを必要とする。信頼度ゲート付きカスケードにより、LLMへのルーティングコストを24-77%削減しつつ同等以上の精度を達成できることを示した。

papers.title: Posterior Flow Matching
papers.summary: Flow matching learns how to transport noise toward data, but its mean prediction does not directly report the endpoint uncertainty remaining at an intermediate state. This paper introduces Posterior Flow Matching (PFM), a general generative modeling framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances with a Gaussian posterior model. The same model evaluation supplies both a transport prediction and endpoint uncertainty, making posterior diagnostics available throughout generation. These learned moments support a mean-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) and a posterior-driven stochastic differential equation (SDE), whose local noise scales adapt to the predicted uncertainty. Across image, point-cloud, molecular, and action generation, PFM improves generation quality and provides endpoint-posterior readouts throughout generation.
papers.title_ja: ポスターフローマッチング
papers.summary_ja: フローマッチングにおいて、中間状態でのエンドポイントの不確実性を直接推定できない問題を解決するため、ガウス後验モデルを用いた新しい生成モデル枠組み「Posterior Flow Matching (PFM)」を提案する。この手法は条件付き速度の平均と分散を学習し、生成過程全体で後验診断を提供可能にする。学習されたモーメントを用いて、平均駆動の常微分方程式（ODE）と後验駆動の確率微分方程式（SDE）を構築し、予測された不確実性に適応したノイズスケールを実現する。画像、点群、分子、アクション生成において、生成品質の向上とエンドポイント後验の読み取りを同時に達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: 生成モデルの手法だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化との直接的な関連は薄い

papers.title: Enhanced Trading Systems with Intelligent Market Analysis
papers.summary: This paper proposes a hybrid reinforcement learning trading framework integrating intraday market data with transformer-based financial sentiment signals. The system extracts sentiment dynamics and semantic event clusters from financial news and incorporates them into a PPO-based trading agent. Experiments on intraday NSE data demonstrate improved risk-adjusted returns compared to price-only baselines.
papers.title_ja: インテリジェント市場分析による取引システムの強化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、日中市場データとTransformerベースの金融センチメントシグナルを統合したハイブリッド強化学習取引フレームワークを提案する。金融ニュースからセンチメント動態とセマンティックイベントクラスターを抽出し、PPOベースの取引エージェントに組み込む手法を採用している。NSEの日中データを用いた実験では、価格情報のみを用いたベースラインと比較して、リスク調整後リターンが向上することが示された。
